comparison.objective: Hang two glass baubles by threading their wire hooks over stand branches.
comparison.physical_skill: Delicate suspended-object handling and open-hook placement while controlling swing.
comparison.success_condition: Both hooks engaged, grippers clear, baubles slow and hanging together for 2 s; breakage fails.
comparison.reason: Tests hook placement and fragile pendulum control; it has no tool-mediated impact fracture or containment outcome.
